verses.text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.

segments.text: To the voice of my supplications.

verses.text: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

segments.text: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities,

verses.text: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.

segments.text: But there is forgiveness with thee,

verses.text: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.

segments.text: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait,
And in his word do I hope.

verses.text: My soul waiteth for the Lord More than watchmen wait for the morning; Yea, more than watchmen for the morning.
O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.

segments.text: For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness,
And with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.text: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
